headline_marked: [[Markets in Dhaka to remain closed]] on Thursday, July 9
headline: Markets in Dhaka to remain closed on Thursday, July 9
summary: Residents planning to shop in Dhaka today should check this list to avoid disappointment, as several major markets and shopping centers will be closed.
details: Dhaka residents often visit markets and shopping centers for their daily needs or special purchases. However, finding a desired shop closed upon arrival can be frustrating and a waste of time.
To help shoppers, here is a list of markets and shopping complexes in Dhaka that will remain closed today, Thursday, July 9. This information is crucial for planning your day effectively.

Markets in the Mohammadpur and Mirpur areas include Mohammadpur Town Hall Market, Krishi Market, BRTC Market, Shyamoli Hall Market, Muktijoddha Supermarket, Mazar Co-operative Market, Mukta Bangla Shopping Complex, Shah Ali Supermarket, and Mirpur Stadium Market.

Other significant closures include Mouchak Market, Anarkali Market, Fortune Shopping Mall, Ayesha Shopping Complex, Karnaphuli Garden City, Concord Twin Tower, Eastern Plus, City Heart, Jonaki Super Market, Gazi Bhaban, Paltan Super Market, Stadium Market-1 & 2, Gulistan Complex, Ramna Bhaban, Khaddar Market, Pir Yameni Market, Baitul Mukarram Market, and Sakura Market.
caption:
